decisions.reason: As a multi-model desk system that extends the core office offering and likely absorbed meaningful development and launch resources, management is inclined to justify that investment and keep it.
A chair family is close to the firm's established furniture business, so even if performance is mixed, its fit with the existing range and the public launch support continued commitment.

Although more niche than the firm's main furniture lines, this multi-model extension still builds on the existing interior concept and prior investment makes management somewhat reluctant to withdraw it quickly.
The sofa was publicly introduced with a designer-led promise and sits near the firm's core lounge offering, which encourages management to persist unless failure becomes unmistakable.
The high standing table is close to the established contract and workplace portfolio, so management can plausibly frame weaker results as temporary and keep it in the line.
Even though the rug collection is more distant from the traditional offer, its status as a flagship and directional product creates strong escalation of commitment and makes withdrawal unlikely.
